title: agent-foundry order
description: The validated input gate of the agent-foundry factory. A tenant submits exactly one of these per order. Every downstream step (assembly, provisioning, run, metering) consumes this document and holds the invariants below. Mirrors ORDER.md section 1.

order_id.description: Tenant-assigned order id. Never parsed by the bus; every subject names tenant + bot slug, not an id the bus must chase.

tenant_id.description: Tenant-assigned. Validated against the API key by the gateway (Phase 3). A tenant can only act on its own order.

goal.description: The single objective the army must hit.

bot_count.description: ANY integer >= 1, unbounded (1, 2, 9000). NOT a one/many enum. bot_count > 1 uses the same assembly as == 1 repeated across bus fan-out. Treating one specific N as a distinct code path is a defect.

scope.description: Goal-specific parameter block. Free-form today; a specific army's manifest pins its shape.

mode.description: firstile = filter-first (function or single frontier call). train_candidate on an order is held, gated and NOT run by the factory.

train_gate.description: deferred today; makes concrete WHICH LoRA we would distil and its gating metric so the factory never silently trains.

created_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the order was created.

run_id.description: Optional. Assigned at submit time to correlate one end-to-end run across every node's metering rows.
